runs: How can I share my broadcast on >x<?
You can share your broadcasts on >x< if you’ve connected your >x< account to your Periscope account.

If you created your Periscope account using your >x< account, you should be all set to share to >x<. If this isn’t the case, you’ll be prompted to connect your >x< account in the Broadcast Tab. Once you’ve connected your >x< account, you can follow the steps below to share a broadcast to >x<.

How do I make edits to my broadcast?

You can edit your broadcast titles, change your thumbnail, and select a custom start point for your replays. All edits will be visible in the replay, and thumbnail and start point edits will be reflected in posts.
Keep in mind that broadcast titles can only be edited up to three times. Additionally, it will take up to 15 minutes for edits to appear in >x<, and up to a minute for them to appear in Periscope.
